To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) participants agreed that they prefer multiple representations to a one; 2) they preferred redundant text to text and image and redundant sound to image and sound; and 3) they preferred detailed and colored images with text and sound to images with text only or sound only.

learners prefer: 1) multiple representations to a sole representation; 2) sound and text to text or sound; 3) detailed images to simple images; 4) highly colored images to images without color; 5) text that explains images to images without text; 6) text and images to images and sound; 7) text and images with sound to images and sound without text; 8) text and images that are not relevant to images that are irrelevant.
